summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting that RPC, Inc. declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.04 per share, payable June 10, 2026, to holders of record May 11, 2026. This is a routine capital return event, not a special situation such as a one-time dividend increase, special dividend, or share repurchase. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics beyond the dividend declaration are included. There is no risk-arb or special-situation angle; the dividend is ordinary course.
